[Data utilities] Converts a date-time from one IANA time zone to another, or gives the current time in a zone, with ISO 8601 output, UTC offsets, abbreviation, whether DST is in effect and the next DST change, and flags times skipped or repeated by DST. Input: to, optional from (default UTC) and datetime (default now). Offline.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 date/time (2026-11-01T09:30, optional Z or +08:00), Unix seconds, or now (default)

from.description: IANA zone the datetime is in (default UTC)

to.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Kuala_Lumpur or UTC

name: time_convert
title: Time zone conversion (IANA zones, offsets, DST)
